summary: Iteration 10 backend testing for the new JackTV admin module. All 11 tests passed (100%). Validated GET /api/jacktv/overlay-config returns all 14 JACKTV_DEFAULTS keys with correct default site_url (https://jack09eo.mpstickv5m73jgravity.my). Confirmed GET and PATCH /api/admin/jacktv/config require auth (401 without Authorization). Regression on /api/jacktv/sports, /api/jacktv/all-matches and the public daddy/football/sports endpoints all green.
critical_code_review_comments: extensions.py is now 2412 lines — well above the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting JackTV admin module, sports module, daddy module, etc., into dedicated routers.

_save_jacktv_config writes via $set of the full merged cfg, which works but couples persistence with the in-memory defaults; if JACKTV_DEFAULTS gains new keys later, every saved doc will be auto-augmented at read-time only (good), but writes after a partial PATCH still persist all keys. Acceptable, just noting that admin reset-to-default requires deleting the doc.

_init_jacktv_runtime() silently swallows errors with logger.warning — acceptable, but failures will be invisible from the API surface. Consider exposing last-init status via /api/admin/jacktv/config for observability.
test_credentials: Not needed — only public + 401 contract testing performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: JackTV admin endpoints live at: GET /api/jacktv/overlay-config (public), GET /api/admin/jacktv/config (admin), PATCH /api/admin/jacktv/config (admin, JackTvConfigPatch body). Mongo stores config in collection app_config with _id='jacktv'. On read the doc is merged over JACKTV_DEFAULTS (so missing keys fall back to defaults). On PATCH, jack07.set_site_url + jack07.reset_client are called to propagate the new base URL. At startup, server.py:startup_warmup calls _init_jacktv_runtime() which pushes the saved site_url into jack07. The current Mongo state already has admin-applied overrides (iframe_header_height=80, iframe_bottom_ratio=0.3) — site_url still matches the default. All public/regression endpoints OK.
